name: The tea stall's thin margin
opensWhen: The player becomes a regular at the tea stall by the bus stand and hears that the monsoon is eating its margin.
note: INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md: Farida Qadri's narrow-margin stall at Shanti Chai Corner, and the 'reconcile a shop daybook' activity (SCHOOL_AND_PROGRESSION.md). The practical-project arc of ROADMAP M3-17. The stallkeeper is a role, so any neighbourhood stall keeper can fill it. Authored draft.

expression.observe: On wet mornings the stall opens late and the steel tumblers go out half filled.
She mentions that the daybook does not add up and that the supplier wants cash on Thursday.
The shutter comes down an hour early and the school crowd drifts to another corner.
The evening shutter stays down. A handwritten notice says she will be back soon.
You find the missing line in the daybook together. The supplier is paid, and she shows you where the tumblers are kept.
A few regulars take turns on the Thursday stock run. The stall keeps its hours.
The stall settles into shorter hours. The school crowd finds another corner and she stops mentioning it.
It is the busiest night of the year, and she cannot afford the stock to meet it.
